function.name: update_availability_windows
function.description: Saves the caller's complete current availability as structured time windows, replacing any previously saved windows entirely. Recompute the FULL current set every time you call this — including after the caller rejects an offered slot — not just the newly mentioned part. Call get_current_timestamp first if you need to resolve a relative date like 'tomorrow' or 'next Tuesday'.

requestID.description: The id returned by get_new_requestID for this service request

availability_windows.description: The caller's complete current set of availability windows
